reviewAxes.note: The edit-baseline finding was independently identified on both axes.

resolvedFindings.problem: A live refreshed version or a reopened saved draft could silently adopt newer shared edits while retaining older local content.
resolvedFindings.fix: Capture and persist the edit baseline with its draft; advance only after explicit conflict review. Older drafts without a baseline require review.
regressions: open editor receives a newer comment prop
reload of a draft with an older baseline

resolvedFindings.problem: Publication validation discarded oversized failed drafts on hydration and the next autosave could overwrite them.
resolvedFindings.fix: Recover drafts through the same safe node/link vocabulary with separate draft-size limits; keep unsupported data inert and retained until explicit replacement.
regressions: 10,001-character draft reload and failed publication retains saved text
unsupported saved content is read-only and not overwritten

resolvedFindings.problem: An open mention picker could mutate editor content after its command had been frozen for submission/retry.
resolvedFindings.fix: Close the picker at submission and disable/guard insertion while pending or retrying.
regressions: submit with open mention targets cannot append an unsent mention

resolvedFindings.problem: An identity switch during moderation left controls pending or allowed an old completion to reset a newer operation.
resolvedFindings.fix: Reset moderation state per identity/issue and fence completions with request tokens and identity epoch.
regressions: new identity is unblocked while old moderation is pending
old completion cannot clear the new identity request or permit a duplicate

browser.environment: local production build, two real Better Auth sessions and isolated acceptance database
checks: lost response plus reload exact replay

previewGate.requirement: Both forge-app and forge-preview-runtime must be READY with successful checks for the final pushed PR head. Check app and runtime live/ready endpoints. Exact final deployment IDs, commit and responses are recorded in the Linear review completion comment after deployment.
